Neutral Citation No. - 2025:Ahc-Lko:27036
Court No. - 15

Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 3976 of 2025
Applicant :- Asif Naseem
Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Lko.

And Another
Counsel for Applicant :- Surekha Patel
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.,Kuldeep Srivastava
Hon'ble Subhash Vidyarthi,J.
1. Heard Sri Harsh Singh and Shri Pratik Raj, learned counsel for the applicant, Sri Mohd. Asif
Khan, learned Aga-I for the State, Sri Abhedya Rajeev, Advocate holding brief of Sri Kuldeep
Srivastava, learned counsel for the Enforcement Directorate, and perused the record.

2. The instant application has been filed seeking release of the applicant on bail in Case Crime
No.121 of 2020 under Sections 409, 420, 467, 468, 471, 120-B, I.P.C. registered at Police Station-
Gomti Nagar, District- Lucknow.

3.  The aforesaid case has been registered on the basis of an F.I.R. alleging that the informant had made some investments in Shine City Infrastructure Pvt. Ltd. Company under allurement of lucrative returns but no returns were paid to the informant.

entities.text: Shine City Infrastructure Pvt. Ltd. Company
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: The applicant has been described as a Director of the Company.
4. In the affidavit filed in support of the bail application, it has been stated that about 527 other F.I.Rs have been lodged throughout the State arising out of similar disputes.
The applicant has been Asif Naseem vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Lko. ...

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
on 8 May, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/161548288/
1 named in some of the F.I.Rs.
The applicant has already been granted bail in 14 other matters of similar nature.
5. Learned counsel for the applicant states that the applicant is languishing in jail since 01.11.2021 and even charges have not been framed till date.
6. The purpose of keeping an under trial person in custody is to ensure his availability to face the trial.

When the applicant is languishing in jail since 01.11.2021 and in spite of expiry of a period of more than three and a half years since the applicant was taken into custody, the trial has not even commenced till date, it appears that the purpose of keeping the applicant in custody is not being achieved.
Numerous other co-accused persons have already been granted bail in similar cases and the applicant has also been granted bail in 14 other cases of similar nature.
7. Keeping in view the aforesaid facts, I am of the view that the applicant is also entitled to be released on bail in the aforesaid case.
8 Accordingly, this bail application stands allowed.
Order Date :- 8.5.2025 -Amit K-
